lessonTitle: 38. Cavalieri's principle and the volume of a ball
lessonTitleEnglish: Cavalieri's principle and the volume of a ball
unit: Geometry · Chapter 9. Volumes and surfaces of solids of revolution
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 12 mathematics textbooks (advanced stream)

stages.headline: Cavalieri's principle: if every plane parallel to a given one cuts two solids in sections of equal area, the solids have equal volumes.
stages.headlineEnglish: Cavalieri's principle: if every plane parallel to a given one cuts two solids in sections of equal area, the solids have equal volumes.

stages.headline: A ball of radius R has volume V = (4/3)πR³.
stages.headlineEnglish: A ball of radius R has volume V = (4/3)πR³.

stages.headline: Archimedes: a ball has 2/3 of the volume of its circumscribed cylinder: (4/3)πR³ : 2πR³ = 2/3.
stages.headlineEnglish: Archimedes: a ball has 2/3 of the volume of its circumscribed cylinder: (4/3)πR³ : 2πR³ = 2/3.
